method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: No readable car or phone; labels on dark plates.
notes.fix: Car roof rail and window phone in the bottom right quarter, lens the convergence point.

notes.problem: Convergence point a glow on an unreadable slab; small dog.
notes.fix: Camera over the rear quarter so roof rail, glass and phone fill the bottom fifth.

notes.problem: Dog about 1/12 of the frame, convergence point an unmodelled slab.
notes.fix: Tighten the fov to about 20 so the box and dog fill a third of the frame.

notes.problem: Primitive monitor, flat UI mock, lifted wall, named person absent.
notes.fix: Reviewer's dark shoulder and forearm silhouette lit by the screen, wall to true black.

notes.problem: Kit monitor, flat wall, grey placeholder bars.
notes.fix: Check labels as type on the screen rows.

notes.problem: Primitive monitor, blank grey check bars, flat clip, subject under half the frame.
notes.fix: Push in so the screen fills two thirds of the frame and set the four check labels as DOM type on the lit rows.

notes.problem: Phone on a stalk pedestal, not clamped to glass.
notes.fix: Model the clamp jaws gripping the lowered glass edge.

notes.problem: Primitive phone on a stand, no glass.
notes.fix: Clamp jaws on the lowered glass; phone back to camera with lens rings.

notes.problem: Phone on a pedestal stem, no legible door, glass edge or clamp.
notes.fix: Model the rear door frame and lowered glass edge filling the lower half with the clamp gripping the glass.

notes.problem: Empty clay band above a low slab.
notes.fix: Rule at about half height, block a third of the width or more, crop the dead band.

notes.problem: Featureless grey slab, plain cube report plug.
notes.fix: Rake the key low, cut three month courses into the block, make the plug a bound sheet stack.
Camera to 0.45 m, crop the foreground.

notes.problem: SDF body reads as a clay toy, bottom 35 percent empty concrete.
notes.fix: Turn the dog fully away and drop the camera to ground level for a rim-lit silhouette against the tail lamps.

notes.problem: A second 8x4 grid straight after slide 6.
notes.fix: Low oblique raking view across mould and cast.
Scale 1.4 times to bleed both edges.

notes.problem: Uniform lattice, lumpy tops, wedge leak.
notes.fix: Irregular street network, remove the wedge.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
rounds_declared_note: the cards carry a round number and it was not believed, because the cards carry [1, 1, None] and a round is one number. `rounds` is this module's own count of 1
work_order: no judge found a hard fail, and the median 6.546 is under this round's rung of 8.0. KEEP EDITING: fix the judges' named defects, re-render and re-score. At the round cap the finished deck ships whatever it scored. Start with the frames the judges charge the art for, in this order, slides 3, 5, 2, 8, 9, 7, 6 (`artwork_weakest_frames`), one concrete change each
craft_floor: pending, because a deck under its rung is sent back by the work order first
